message: The boiler's fixed. The engineer finished about half an hour ago and the hot water is back on. Alex will be home around six.
closing: That's everything. Thanks Sam, bye now.

voicemail.text: Hi Sam, this is Claude, an AI assistant calling for Alex. The boiler's fixed and the hot water is back on. Alex will be home around six. Bye now.

_comment: Tier 0 has no anticipated_questions, prohibitions or caps because there is no LLM in the call path. Claude writes these words before dialling; the call itself is TwiML <Say> and cannot deviate from them. This is why tier 0 is both the cheapest and the safest mode, and why it ships first.
